fields.title: XML column
fields.description: The column containing the XML cells to which the XSLT stylesheets will be applied.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Stylesheet column
fields.description: The column containing the XSLT stylesheets. Each stylesheet will be applied to every XML cell in the XML column, resulting in a collection cell per row (one result per stylesheet).
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Use first stylesheet only
fields.description: If checked, only the first stylesheet of the XSLT stylesheet column is applied. The output column will contain simple cells instead of collection cells.

fields.title: Remove source column
fields.description: If checked, the XML input column does not appear in the output table.

fields.title: New column name
fields.description: The name of the new output column that will contain the transformation results.

fields.title: Output is XML
fields.description: If checked, the output cells will be XML cells. Otherwise, the output cells will be string cells.
